approach: Add one gate-crate predicate attribution::cutover_base(git, commit) (Some(C0) when commit is C0 or descends from it and the cutover is Shown). All writers key on it. Committer::build_commit_in and commit_with_staged (moved onto Committer, Athena delegates) strip Athena-* trailers via a pure strip_athena_trailers in athena-git. Add Git::squash_text_relaxed beside the unchanged strict squash_text, and a new pub(crate) fn squash_text_for(git, landed) in gh.rs that picks strict or relaxed by cutover_base of the landed commit's parent; Athena::land_pr calls it, and the end-to-end test gets its squash text from the same function. gate() drops only invariant::check for a post-C0 parent. Readers keep trailers up to C0 and gain a C0..head fallback by records path. Docs and tests as before.

decisions.choice: Extract squash_text_for(git, landed) -> Result<CommitText> in gh.rs, called by Athena::land_pr and by the end-to-end test.
decisions.reason: The strict/relaxed choice was unreachable from tests without building a full Athena. As a free function it is unit-tested on pre-C0 parent (strict, refuses a trailer-free commit) and post-C0 parent (relaxed). Reverting land_pr to strict would not be caught by the function test alone, so land_pr's call is the single use and the test of the function plus a grep-free single call site keep them tied.

rejected.option: Build a full Athena in the test
rejected.why: Needs agent/driver wiring unrelated to this behavior.

decisions.choice: Key stripping on cutover state Shown (landing record plus import manifest) through one shared predicate in athena-gate::attribution.
decisions.reason: Same switch check_history uses; a trailer-free commit during Pending would fail the old rules. No drift between writers, gate and readers.

rejected.option: Strip once the landing record exists
rejected.why: History check still uses old rules while Pending.
The repo's own athena.toml names it, so all existing tests would lose trailers.

decisions.choice: Move commit_with_staged onto Committer; Athena method delegates.
decisions.reason: Needed for strip and for tests without a full Athena.

rejected.option: Make Athena method pub(crate) and build Athena in tests

decisions.choice: Strip at the choke points build_commit_in and commit_with_staged with pure strip_athena_trailers, touching only a final all-trailer paragraph and only Athena- keys.
decisions.reason: Many callers build trailers; one point covers them and the gate sees the committed message.

decisions.choice: gate() skips only invariant::check for post-C0 parents in every scope.
decisions.reason: invariant reads trailers; content and jobs checks do not.

rejected.why: It reads records, dropping it weakens validation.

decisions.choice: Keep trailer readers and add a C0..head fallback by the records a job adds (landed_commit, status trace, auditor).
decisions.reason: Post-C0 commits have no Athena-Job trailer.

rejected.why: Out of scope; pre-C0 history needs them.

decisions.choice: In the end-to-end test, build the squash commit with commit_tree from the chosen CommitText (title plus body), set FakeHost.merge_makes to it, and assert on that commit's message. Assert landing record commits[].sha equals exactly the job branch range base..head in order, and check no Athena- line on each.
decisions.reason: FakeHost does not build commits from the text; commits[].sha is the faithful reading for a squash (single parent), and the range equality proves every PR commit is covered.

rejected.option: Walk the landing record's second parent
rejected.why: A squash host commit has one parent.

decisions.choice: Drop the phrase test in lifecycle.rs; criterion 7 is verified by reading the docs.
decisions.reason: A phrase check proves words, not accuracy (critic finding 4). lifecycle.rs stays unchanged unless a clear CLI assertion is easy.

risks.risk: Trailer-free post-C0 commits refused by hooks or readers that require trailers (jobs::check, pr_check, run.rs).
risks.mitigation: gate() drops invariant::check for post-C0 parents; the end-to-end test builds all three commit kinds through the real gate; retry_landing listed as open question.

risks.risk: cutover_base runs on every commit build and gate call.
risks.mitigation: Returns early when cutover_job is unset.

risks.risk: Stripping changes pre-C0 behavior or existing tests.
risks.mitigation: Strip only when cutover_base is Some; existing tests not edited.

risks.risk: End-to-end test is large and fragile.
risks.mitigation: Reuse cutover_world, World and FakeHost; build the squash commit with commit_tree from the real CommitText.
Touches only a final all-trailer paragraph and only Athena- keys; unit tests for prose-only, mixed and empty-after-strip.

risks.risk: Another caller of strict squash_text runs post-C0.
risks.mitigation: Only Athena::land_pr calls it; it now goes through squash_text_for.

demonstrations.method: records_flow test: cutover_world(true) lands the cutover job. Build one job branch with an intervention commit (Committer::commit_with_staged), a records-only commit (Committer::commit_records) and the job landing commit (Committer::build_commit) with Athena-Job, Athena-Verified-Content, Co-Authored-By trailers. Get CommitText from squash_text_for, build the squash commit with commit_tree from it, set merge_makes to it, and land via land_pr.
demonstrations.observes: Squash commit message and each of the three PR commits (landing record commits[].sha, asserted equal to the job branch range base..head in order) have no line starting 'Athena-'; Co-Authored-By survives.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the strip or the relaxed text from squash_text_for, the commits carry Athena- lines (and strict squash_text refuses the trailer-free landing commit).

demonstrations.method: Same scratch repo; read the landing record from the records branch, call check_history and check_attribution on the post-C0 base. No CLI athena check is added.
demonstrations.observes: Kinds are [declared_intervention, records_only, job_landing] in order; check_history and check_attribution report nothing.
demonstrations.fails_without: Trailer-free commits judged by old rules, or an unrecorded squash, give violations or wrong kinds.

demonstrations.method: athena-git unit tests: strict squash_text keeps trailers with exactly one Athena-Job and refuses none/two; squash_text_relaxed on a commit with Athena-Job, Athena-Verified-Content, Co-Authored-By, and on one with none. gh.rs tests of squash_text_for with a pre-C0 parent (strict; refuses a trailer-free commit) and a post-C0 parent (relaxed).
demonstrations.command: cargo test -p athena-git squash_text && cargo test -p athena-core squash_text_for
demonstrations.observes: Strict form unchanged; relaxed body has no Athena- line, keeps Co-Authored-By and prose, does not error without Athena-Job; squash_text_for picks each form by the parent's cutover state.
demonstrations.fails_without: A relaxed form that keeps trailers fails the no-Athena- assertion; one requiring Athena-Job errors on a trailer-free commit; a squash_text_for always strict fails the post-C0 case.

demonstrations.method: Repo A (cutover Shown), B (no cutover_job), C (cutover_job named, no landing record): call commit_records and commit_with_staged with Athena-Job, Athena-Intervention, Co-Authored-By trailers. Plus full cargo test with no edits to existing tests.
demonstrations.observes: A: no Athena- line, Co-Authored-By kept. B and C: trailers exactly as given. Existing suite passes.
demonstrations.fails_without: No strip keeps trailers in A; a strip without the cutover check removes them in B and C and breaks existing tests.

demonstrations.method: history.rs cutover_tests: a trailer-free post-C0 tip with a content violation, a governed change with no trailer, and a bad job record. A lib.rs test runs gate(Change::of_commit(post), Scope::Commit) on it; a pre-C0 parent control.
demonstrations.observes: check_history reports no Size, PersonalData, Invariant or jobs violation (only secrets and attribution run) while check_history_with_exempt reports them; gate() reports Size/PersonalData and the jobs violation but no Rule::Invariant; a pre-C0 parent still gets Invariant.
demonstrations.fails_without: If gate kept invariant::check Invariant appears; if it dropped content or jobs the Size/jobs violation vanishes; if check_history ran content Size appears.

demonstrations.method: status.rs, auditor.rs and gh.rs landed_commit tests on a scratch repo with a pre-C0 commit with Athena-Job: X and a post-C0 trailer-free commit adding X's records; plus a no-cutover control.
demonstrations.observes: trace lists both commits; read_changed_files reads the files; landed_commit returns the post-C0 commit; the control equals trailer-only results.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the fallback the post-C0 commit is missing and the auditor/landed_commit fail with 'cannot audit job' / 'is not landed on this branch'.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff. CHANGELOG entry and D111 follow-up (job 7 part 1b) state that writers stop after C0, which readers still use trailers up to C0 (legacy history rule, trace, auditor, landed_commit with fallback), that after C0 the history check runs only secrets and attribution, and the gate drops only the invariant check.
demonstrations.observes: Both files carry the entries, matching check_after_cutover in history.rs.

demonstrations.method: Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo test --locked, then git diff --stat.
demonstrations.observes: All clean; no athena.toml, defaults.toml or ci.yml in the diff.
demonstrations.fails_without: Any format, lint or test failure, or a governance file in the diff.
